# Edgewood Dental Care

> > Edgewood Dental Care is a comprehensive dental practice in Edgewood, KY offering general dentistry, implants, sedation, and family dental services under the leadership of Dr. Kevin McMahon and four additional dentists.

Located in Northern Kentucky, Edgewood Dental Care serves the Edgewood and Cincinnati area with modern facilities, advanced technology including IV sedation and laser therapy, and a team of five experienced dentists. The practice is recognized for patient-centered care, spa-like amenities, and community involvement.
